description: Robot accelerates from 0 to ~0.5 m/s over 2s, maintains speed, decelerates. Max jerk < 0.5 m/s^3.
Angular velocity z stays near 0 during straight-line navigation. std_dev < 0.05 rad/s expected.
Smooth angular velocity z ramp up/down during in-place rotation. No spikes > 3× mean.
During idle, z acceleration should be ~9.81 m/s^2, x/y near 0. std_dev < 0.1.
During arm manipulation, base should remain nearly stationary. linear.x < 0.05 m/s.
